name: Gyaku Kyuuketsuki ni Goyoujin!
source:
The ritual took place in a dark room. The boy Jig was seeking a powerful dark magic, and was about to summon the denizens of the darkness...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25621]Freem[/url]]
